subject.title: Control UI: transient group catalog failure is latched for entire connection

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106169 become the canonical fix, or is the narrower retry-on-next-sync behavior in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106167 preferred?
rationale: Both PRs address the demonstrated latch, but they establish different retry timing and stale-response behavior; choosing the permanent Control UI state-machine contract requires maintainer review.

options.title: Canonicalize comprehensive fix
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106169 with bounded automatic retry and generation protection, then close the narrower candidate as superseded.

options.title: Prefer narrow retry
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106167 so retries occur only on later synchronization, accepting that recovery is not proactively scheduled.

options.title: Consolidate candidates
options.body: Ask the two PRs to converge on one minimal state-machine design and retain the strongest focused and browser regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize comprehensive fix
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106169 with bounded automatic retry and generation protection, then close the narrower candidate as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the comprehensive candidate and are best positioned to explain the intended retry and stale-response semantics.
